question.problem:
Negate the following statement: 

$\,$ At least one sequence is geometric.
question.worked_solution:
Let $S$ be the set of all sequences. The given statement can be re-phrased as follows:

$\,$ There exists $s\in S$ such that $s$ is geometric.

Introducing the existential quantifier, we get the following:

$\,$ $∃s\in S,\,s\text{ is geometric}.$

Negating this, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}¬(∃s\in S,\,s\text{ is geometric}) & ≡∀s\in S,\,¬(s\text{ is geometric}) \\  & ≡∀s\in S,\,s\text{ is not geometric}\end{aligned}
$$

which reads 

$\,$ For all $s\in S,$ $s$ is not geometric.

or simply

$\,$ Every sequence is not geometric.

choices.value: At least one sequence is not geometric.
At least one sequence is geometric.
